plugins.description: A whole AI crew inside Claude Code that builds, reviews, tests, writes and reports: a Mate (first mate) that learns your style, switchable agents (engineer, QA, reviewer, analyst, writer and more), a private Keelcrew board, team packs, fixed rules so merges and posts wait for your OK, and a panel that wakes the Mate when you act on the board.
